summary: Rambong Muay Thai Gym is a Muay Thai gym just south of the Old City in Chiang Mai, led by ONE Championship fighter Rambong Therapat, offering group and private training and fight preparation.

facts.label: Monthly group
facts.value: 9,500 THB for 1 month, one group session daily

facts.label: Schedule
facts.value: Morning and afternoon sessions, Monday to Saturday
facts.quote: We run Muay Thai sessions each morning and afternoon, Monday to Saturday, closed Sundays.

facts.label: Class length
facts.quote: Our Muay Thai classes usually run for 60 to 90 minutes

facts.label: Head trainer
facts.value: Led by ONE Championship fighter Rambong Therapat
facts.quote: led by ONE Championship fighter Rambong Therapat

facts.label: Location
facts.value: 79/2 Sripingmuang 3 Road, Haiya, south of the Old City
facts.quote: We are located just south of the Old City
